6 تجاودوا They considered [or tried] which of them had the best argument, or plea, or allegation: (K, TA:) so says Aboo-Sa'eed on the authority of an Arab of the desert. (TA.) And يَتَجَاوَدُونَ الحَدِيثَ They consider, or see, [or try,] which of them will be best in narration, or talk, or discourse. (A.) ―
-b2- [Also They vied, or contended together for superiority, in liberality, bounty, munificence, or generosity.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
